name: car-dealership-manager-tycoon
description: Car Dealership Manager Tycoon — a management game for PC browsers and Android. Buy, prepare and sell cars; grow a used-car lot into an automotive empire.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node tools/qa/smoke.cjs && node tools/qa/playthrough.cjs && node tools/qa/playthrough.cjs build/qa phone && node tools/qa/flows.cjs && node tools/qa/build.cjs && node tools/qa/build.cjs build/qa phone
scripts.apk: npm run build && python3 tools/apk/build_apk.py && python3 tools/apk/verify_apk.py
scripts.android:gradle: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
